report.explanation: Only one error span exists: gateway 'call payment' at 911ms ERROR. Order checkout span is OK (71ms), and gateway/order metrics and logs are healthy (error_rate 0.0014, p95 70ms, status 200). The order deploy (3.3.3, 491 min old, valid config) cannot establish causation. Current evidence is insufficient to bound a root cause; payment-side telemetry is required.
missing_evidence: Traces for the order->payment call path to confirm whether payment latency/errors originate downstream of order
Payment service metrics (error rate, p95 latency, timeouts) during the incident window
Gateway error logs or span error details for the failing 'call payment' span
Baseline comparison of payment latency to determine if 911ms is anomalous
